answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we use Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent must lock $500 in collateral. Second, the agent submits a cryptographically signed TPM quote from secure hardware. Third, the network validates this unique hardware fingerprint against a global registry. To launch a 100-node attack, an adversary faces a cost of $50,000 in bonds and 72 hours of intensive verification. This ensures that creating fake identities remains prohibitively expensive. It is like a tiny sparrow attempting to chip away at a massive marble monument using only a single sliver of ivory.
